findings.title: Journal search shows a malformed API response as a list of blank matching entries
findings.expected: A malformed response is shown as a load error, not as search results
findings.actual: The page says '14 entries match' and lists 14 cards that show only '–', with no error
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["14 entries match"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","14 entries match","–","–","–","–","–","–"]} | {"alerts":["14 entries match"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","14 entries match","–","–","–","–","–","–"]}

findings.title: Plant journal section shows a malformed response as fake entries with Edit/Delete buttons
findings.expected: An error saying the journal could not load
findings.actual: Several entries dated '–' with no text show up, each with 'Edit entry from –' and 'Delete entry from –' buttons, and there is no alert
findings.evidence: {"seg":["Entries, newest first","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–"],"alerts":[]} | {"seg":["Entries, newest first","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–"],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: Plant journal shows an invalid (empty-object) response as 'No journal entries yet' while the badge counts entries
findings.actual: It shows the 'No journal entries yet' empty state with no alert, while the badge says '2 entries'
findings.evidence: {"seg":["Entries, newest first","No journal entries yet","Note what you see: first shoots, pests, the weather.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]} | {"seg":["Entries, newest first","No journal entries yet","Note what you see: first shoots, pests, the weather.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: No way to retry after the plant journal fails to load without reloading the page
findings.expected: A Retry button, or some other way to load the journal again once the fault clears
findings.actual: Only the error text 'Injected 500' shows, and there is no retry control in the Journal section
